Our sole pole vaulter Cameron Johnston fought hard for a season’s best of 4.60m and spearman James Everard, body still aching from injury sustained while high jumping in BAL2, was close to 60m to place 4th.

Now recovered from surgery Wes flew in from Finland for his first competition since the accident and tentatively threw just under 53m to back up James Everard who gained a useful fourth in the A javelin.
